### CVE-2000-0506
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2000-10-13 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 20001: Linux Kernel 2.2.x 2.4.0-test1 (SGI ProPack 1.2/1.3) - Sendmail 8.10.1 Capabilities Privilege Escalation (2) (local/linux, 2000-06-07, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 20000: Linux Kernel 2.2.x 2.4.0-test1 (SGI ProPack 1.2/1.3) - Sendmail Capabilities Privilege Escalation(1) (local/linux, 2000-06-07, verified=1)

The "capabilities" feature in Linux before 2.2.16 allows local users to cause a denial of service or gain privileges by setting the capabilities to prevent a setuid program from dropping privileges, aka the "Linux kernel setuid/setcap vulnerability."
